She also gets the weapon back in her hand only when that one flight ends, not before.

Watch her throw in a PvP match: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Dev diary, a bug you could count: when Zena threw her chakram, the first leg flew back to her on its own while the ricochet and return also played, so two discs were in the air.

Now one attack owns the whole flight: one disc out, off every bounce, back to her hand, caught once.

Nature's Board Units synergy adds 2, 3 or 4 more on top, so the absolute cap is 12. The paid tiers also deepen your zone, and the top one opens the side edge.

Try your split in a PvP match: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Every ranked army drafts six creatures. The Placement augment sets how many stacks they can become: 6 for free, 7 for 1 point, 8 for 2.

Splitting adds no bodies, and each half fights at lower stack power.

So when do you pay for an eighth stack instead of another augment level?

Not the same as the Sniper augment: that one widens the bands in whole cells but never removes falloff. Only the built-in Sniper ability and the Farsight Quiver artifact keep a shot at full damage at any distance. Try both shooters: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Range falloff counts in square bands of whole cells. An Elf (shot distance 7.75) hits full out to 7 cells, half to 14, a quarter past that. The Arbalester's distance is just 5, but Sniper skips the bands: full damage from any cell on the 16x16 board. Which back row do you trust?

Normal is open stone. FIRE PIT has lava in the middle until lap 10. Barrels puts 12 destructible barrels across the four central columns. Which pick do you hold back for the map? Draft one: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Ranked deals one of three maps the moment a draft starts, and it is never rerolled. Unless you took Spymaster, you only see it after both Level-2 picks.

So the early picks have to work on any board. Level 3, the Tier-2 artifact and Level 4 are where you draft for this one.

It also loses its counter-shot: a shooter answers a shot only when it could shoot right now, so while an enemy touches it, your own archers can shoot it with nothing coming back.

Try both sides of it in a PvP match: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

One diagonal step can switch a shooter off.

An enemy in any touching cell, corners included, stops it shooting, and its melee hits, attacks and answers alike, deal half damage.

Only Might's Centaur and Zena (Handyman) hit in full up close.

Dive their shooter, or screen yours?

Luck runs from -10 to +10. Each point also adds 1 percentage point to the stack's own ability chances, so a lucky Pikeman locks targets with Aggr a little more often.

Try it in the sandbox or ranked: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

In Heroes of Crypto, luck is mostly a defense stat.

A lucky stack takes about 1% less attack damage per point, an unlucky one about 1% more. Spells ignore it. It re-rolls every lap: faction base (Nature +4, Chaos -1) plus a fresh -3 to +3.

Would you ever draft for it?

Magic resistance can resist it, a Peasant's Absorb Penalties can take it (and it does nothing there), Magic Mirror can reflect it, and it isn't reapplied while active. Do you aim your Dryads at the flyers or at whatever is closest? https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Your best brake on enemy flyers might be a level-1 archer.

Each Dryad attack, not its return fire, has a 40% chance at full stack, plus 1% per point of luck, to Hamstring a flyer: 30% less movement for its next 3 turns.

Add Quagmire and that flyer keeps about half its reach.

Flyers with 100% magic resistance are skipped, and full stack is measured against the biggest stack on the board, so a grown enemy stack can lock it. Tome of Amplification lifts your flyers to +5.4 armor. Cast it into flyers, or save it? https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Valkyrie's Wind Flow doesn't pick sides. Once per fight, at full stack, every flyer on the board gets +4 armor and -4 movement for 3 laps: yours, theirs, and the Valkyrie herself. Enemies can't resist it. It brakes a flying rush, but the flyers you slowed get tougher to kill.

Stack power sets it: 3, 6, 9, 12 or 15%. A Broken Satyr gives nothing, and the bonus adds to Empower and the Mage's Ring artifacts as one sum. Do you hide it at the back or let it bait a dive? Test it: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

The Satyr's best hit is one it never throws. While it lives, every ally anywhere on the board deals +15% magic damage at full stack. Two Satyrs don't add up; only the strongest counts. So the first question your opponent asks is simple: can they reach your Satyr?

Luck shifts the 50%, and splitting the Peasant weakens it. It also catches Spit Ball and Hamstring (useless on a Peasant, it doesn't fly), and an absorbed Harpy Castling swaps the Harpy with the Peasant.

Who stands next to your Peasants?

https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Counter-intuitive rule: your Peasants can take curses for your best stack.

Absorb Penalties Aura covers allies within 2 cells. When an enemy spell debuff lands on one, a full-stack Peasant has a 50% chance to take it instead.

Stuns, blindness and poison still go through.

Losses lock it too: at 80% or less of the biggest stack's experience, it's below power 5. Life's Supply synergy at level 3 does it from the other side. When it fires, it hits every enemy in a 3x3 block anywhere.

Cast it on lap one, or hold it?

https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Counter-intuitive rule: your opponent can lock your Meteor Shower without touching the caster.

It needs stack power 5, and stack power is measured against the biggest stack on the board. Grow one enemy stack big enough and your untouched Magic Dragons drop to 4.

Magic resistance cuts the burn and 100% blocks it. Fire Elements are immune, Water Elements take 1.5x. It lasts until the third lap change after the cast.

Do you use it to cut the enemy's path, or to fence in your own shooters?

Try it: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS

Fire Wall doesn't burn a stack that stands in it. It burns whatever walks in, friend or foe: 25% of the stack's total max health, plus 1 extra step. Armor doesn't help. Flyers only pay where they land. And if the board narrows and shoves you into the flames, you burn.

One catch on her answers: when she retaliates, she counts enemies from before the attacker moved, so the stack that walked in to hit her doesn't add to it. Split stacks get less (+2% per stack power), and it's off while she's Broken.

Try it: https://t.co/gdYw9HVfcS
